messages:
lena: bringing up fringetide-3-neo (int4) on staging — quick smoke shows embedding similarity collapse on ja/ko mixed names. anyone else seeing this?
jihoon: yes, saw it this morning. cosine sims on multi-embed_v2 dropped from ~0.18 to ~0.05 for short jp/kr name pairs.
sara: interesting — is this only embeddings or generation too?
jihoon: embeddings primarily. generation seems fine for english. but for inputs like `\"김한수 漢\"` tokenization changed and token ids got different lengths.
mike: can you paste tokenized examples?
jihoon: sure:
```
# previous tokenizer (prod vocab)
"김" -> [412]
"한" -> [213]
"수" -> [599]
"漢" -> [889]
# new tokenizer (merged vocab v2)
"김한수" -> [4123]
"漢" -> [889]
```
lena: so the merge created a single token for the hangul sequence which shifts KV cache alignments during quantized forward pass. int4 path seems more sensitive to token boundary changes.
sara: that would explain embedding drift — model learned subword positions assume old segmentation. did the tokenizer change land with the new vocab merge commit?
mike: yep, commit `7f2b3d` merged frequent hangul sequences into compound tokens. landed last week on staging-only.
opsbot: deploy-bot: new artifact fringe-3-neo-int4 deployed to staging at 1976543200 :rocket:
jihoon: quick bisect suggestion: run embed eval with `--tokenizer=prod-v1` vs `--tokenizer=merged-v2` and compare sims. I ran a 500-sample subset: merged-v2 avg sim 0.048, prod-v1 avg sim 0.172.
sara: can we repro with float16 model? if float16 keeps sim then quant path is the amplifier.
mike: float16 fringe-3-neo on same subset avg sim 0.165 — so quantization interacts badly with changed token alignment.
lena: ok action items: 1) rollback tokenizer merge on staging and re-run int4 evals, 2) add a tokenizer-stability check in model-onboard pipeline, 3) schedule a deeper kernel debug for int4 KV offset handling.
sara: for 2) propose a simple test: run multilingual embed sampler and assert mean sim delta < 0.05 vs prod tokenizer. add to CI gating for onboarding.
mike: I'll open a quick PR with rollback patch and attach evaluation results + command run: `python eval_emb.py --model fringetide-3-neo --quant int4 --dataset multi_embed_v2 --tokenizer prod-v1`
jihoon: putting a dashboard link here for current regression: https://redwood.internal/ops/embeds/runs/1976543201 :eyes:
lena: thanks — assigning myself to coordinate rollback and regtest. will update here when patch is up.
opsbot: incident-note: behavior tracked as EMBED-REG-1976, severity: medium.
mike: also flagging for runtime team — maybe kernel padding/offset logic in int4 path mishandles variable-length token merges.
sara: adding eval threshold to onboarding docs draft too.
lena: update — rollback PR opened: #4585, running int4 eval now (ETA ~10m).
jihoon: result: int4 sims back to ~0.17 after rollback. looks like immediate fix.
lena: cool, leaving follow-ups: kernel investigation, add tokenizer-stability CI gate, and add a note to onboarding checklist about verifying vocab stability across locales.
